one_liner: GoHighLevel is a comprehensive all-in-one marketing, CRM, and sales platform built specifically for marketing agencies and small businesses.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can independently register applications on the GoHighLevel Developer Marketplace and instantly create Private Integration Tokens in their sub-accounts.

one_liner: Mailchimp is an all-in-one marketing automation platform and email service for managing mailing lists and creating campaigns.
self_serve_evidence: Anyone can create a free Mailchimp account and generate an API key directly from their account settings without sales approval.

one_liner: Klaviyo is a marketing automation platform focused on email and SMS marketing, specifically tailored for e-commerce businesses.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can instantly create a free test account to experiment with custom apps and integrations without risking production data.

one_liner: Pinterest is a visual discovery engine for finding ideas like recipes, home and style inspiration, and managing visual bookmarks.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can instantly register apps and obtain API credentials through the Pinterest developer portal for standard access.

one_liner: SendGrid is a cloud-based customer communication platform that delivers transactional and marketing emails at scale.
self_serve_evidence: Users can sign up for a free SendGrid tier and instantly generate API keys from the settings dashboard after enabling 2FA.

one_liner: Shopify is a complete commerce platform that lets you start, grow, and manage a business with online storefronts and POS systems.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can join the Shopify Partner Program for free and instantly spin up development stores to build and test apps.

one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is an enterprise e-commerce platform for businesses to create seamless shopping experiences across B2C and B2B.
self_serve_evidence: Access to Account Manager credentials and sandbox environments requires an enterprise contract or partner portal approval.
blocker: Requires enterprise contract or partner approval for sandbox access.

one_liner: Squarespace is a website building and hosting platform providing templates and tools for creating sites and online stores.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can request free developer trials, and merchants with Advanced Commerce plans can self-generate API keys in settings.

one_liner: Gumroad is an e-commerce platform empowering creators to sell digital products, memberships, and physical goods directly to their audience.
self_serve_evidence: Anyone can create a free Gumroad account and instantly generate a Personal Access Token in the advanced settings tab.

one_liner: FanBasis provides a payment and financial orchestration infrastructure for integrating various BNPL and checkout options.
self_serve_evidence: Developers can access a free sandbox environment with simulated payment processors to test integrations securely.
